good_sequence.observations: return value of each call; cache is private
good_sequence.assumptions: sequential calls; pure original; no I/O, library calls, concurrency or external cache mutation
good_sequence.initial_state: empty cache {valid=false, key=0, value=0}, retained between calls
good_sequence.bound: exactly three symbolic calls, no loops

good_induction.observations: return value of each call; cache is private
good_induction.assumptions: sequential calls; pure original; no I/O, library calls, concurrency or external cache mutation
good_induction.initial_state: base: empty cache; step: arbitrary state with !valid || value == original(key)
good_induction.bound: initialization obligation plus one symbolic step with invariant preservation; no loops
good_induction.interpretation: If EQ: initialization and step obligations justify induction over finite sequential calls; invariant supplied by hand
